description.zh: 用途：中文维护的第一方 Skill 与项目文档。 不适用：修改第三方上游、企业私有接口或任意替代项目治理契约。 这是可选择的行为偏好，不代表普遍最优做法。
description.en: Use: first-party Skills and project docs maintained in Chinese. Not for: modifying third-party upstream, enterprise-private interfaces, or replacing project governance contracts arbitrarily. This is a selectable behavior preference, not a universally best practice.
